# Aesthetics by Michelle

Licensed skincare and aesthetics services in Hayden, Idaho.
Owner-operator: Michelle Hoffman, Licensed Idaho Esthetician (EST-292960).

## About

Aesthetics by Michelle is a solo-practitioner skincare studio in Hayden, Idaho,
serving the greater Coeur d'Alene, Post Falls, and Spokane Valley area. Michelle
has many years of experience in the beauty industry and holds an Idaho Esthetician
license (EST-292960) issued by the Idaho Barber and Cosmetology Services Licensing Board.

## Services

- Microneedling
- Customized Facials (Classic, Anti-Aging, with Dermaplaning, Microdermabrasion, Body Energy Healing)
- Chemical Peel
- Brow Lamination, Eyelash Lift & Tint
- Eyebrow, Lip, Nostril, Facial, and Underarm Waxing
- Reiki Body Healing
